Name: Ara
Description: The centre of the universe, where all things originated and return. It is widely believed that the cosmos is heaven, and Ara is its anvil.

Name: Samsai
Description: According to the Ensarae faith, this is the lantern beheld by heaven's greatest servant, the lightbearer titan Samsai. He circles the cosmos each day to overlook the good people of Ara.

Name: Pasu
Description: The planet closest to Ara is Pasu. The caretaker elder sister of Ara, Pasiu is so pale that its transparent body can be seen through, but its light that shines through the night allows for safe navigation through the dark.

Name: Adaru
Description: The sleeping dark planet, Adaru. Most of the time, it is unobservable to the naked eye of any being on Ara. It only reveals itself in the daytime sky when near the pale, shining light of Pasiu. On days that it receives effulgence from Pasiu and other planets, it becomes awake, and its temperament emits such that all of the cosmos responds.

Name: Emru
Description: The ferocious, blood-red planet, Emru. The commander of the lower heavenly army. The sky turns red as it approaches Ada for inspection every once in a while.

Name: Takiltu
Description: The purple planet with a golden crown, Takiltu. The lord of the lower heaven who governs the fate and riches of all civilisations.

Name: Ardralu
Description: The green planet, Ardralu. The governor of lower heaven who oversees all of the natural world. The grand ritual to appeal for a bountiful harvest is usually conducted during the retrograde.

Name: Sallummu
Description: Sallummu is the great comet said to be thrown by the great titan Folstyer as a gift for his lover Filarsa during his trip to challenge his rival. Legend is that, unbeknownst to Folstyer, Filarsa died in childbirth years prior. Sallummu still travels across the cosmos in search of its destination ever since.
